history_scope.rule: ancestors of base_sha only; no commit after the base is read

tests.note: Mapping by file name, Go package, or a test in the same component naming the module path. A related test existing or changing says nothing about whether it ran or passed.

ci.note: No CI results supplied (--ci). Do not infer that checks passed.

signal_meanings.change_size: Lines and files changed. Large diffs are harder to review; size alone does not indicate impact.
signal_meanings.dispersion: Components = nearest directory with a package manifest. Several components means the change crosses package boundaries.
signal_meanings.path_classes: Regex classification of paths. A class is a prompt to look, not evidence of a contract change.
signal_meanings.churn: Commit counts per changed file over base ancestry. High churn marks a frequently-modified area; it is not a defect predictor on its own.
signal_meanings.co_change: Files that historically changed together with a changed file but are absent here. Can indicate an incomplete change, or nothing.
signal_meanings.ownership: CODEOWNERS at base and how often the PR's authors previously committed to these files. Contextual only; not a judgement of the author.
signal_meanings.dependencies: Manifest entries whose version spec changed. Lockfile-only resolution changes appear in files, not here.
signal_meanings.tests: Name-based mapping from source files to test files. Existence of a test is not evidence it covers the change or that it passed.
